route_topology_disposition.disclosed_consequence: A signed-in member with exactly one active membership who has never visited the selector now resolves membership=null (TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED) on first reaching an organization-gated route, and the EXISTING (unchanged) redirect logic sends them to /app/onboarding rather than to the selector. This is the measured, accepted consequence of REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_CONTRACT.NO_FALLBACK.single_membership_is_not_an_exception ('an absent selection is a REFUSAL, not an inference') combined with route carve-outs being frozen for S3. Recorded as a disclosed, non-blocking finding for a future UX/routing node, not a defect of this implementation.

enumerator_host_decision.measurement: database-context.ts already imports organizationMembers, organizations and db — hosting the actual query there requires ZERO new import edges. Hosting the query logic in session.ts would require importing organizationMembers/organizations from @/db/schema (2 new symbols) that module does not otherwise need, and would duplicate the exact query shape already established by loadActiveMembershipWithinContext/loadOrganizationWithinContext in database-context.ts. database-context.ts is therefore the measured smaller compliant dependency surface.
